Our aluminium doors, windows and facade systems are designed to deliver superior performance, durability and modern aesthetics, making them ideal for premium residential and commercial architectural projects across India.
Aluminium Windows & Doors in India: A Simple Guide for Modern Home

Are you building a new house or fixing up your old one? One of the first things people notice is the windows and doors. They bring in sunlight, fresh air, and add beauty to any room. These days, more and more families are picking aluminium windows & doors in India instead of wood or steel. There is a solid reason behind this shift.

Aluminium is tough, long-lasting, and does not rust like steel or rot like wood. This makes it ideal for Indian weather, whether you live in a humid coastal town or a hot, dry city. It survives heavy monsoons and burning summers without bending, cracking, or fading.
Why Indian Homes Love Aluminium
Here are plain and simple reasons why homeowners are making the switch:
Fights All Weather
It does not swell in the rain or crack in the heat. Your frames stay smooth and easy to use all year.
Hardly Any Maintenance
You do not need to paint, polish, or worry about termites. A quick wipe with a wet cloth is usually enough.
Sleek and Modern
Aluminium frames are thin but very strong. This gives you more glass space, better views, and a clean look.
Safe from Pests
Unlike wood, aluminium does not attract termites, borers, or other insects.
Good for Nature
Aluminium can be recycled many times, so it is a smarter pick for the environment.
Fits Every Corner of Your House
You can use aluminium windows & doors in India for bedrooms, kitchens, living rooms, and balconies. They come in different colours, shapes, and styles, so matching them with your home is easy.
Sliding doors save space in small flats. Casement windows open wide and let in lots of fresh air.
Fixed windows work well where you want only light, not wind.
No matter the size of your home, there is a design that fits just right.

Do not just pick the cheapest option. Keep these simple tips in mind:

2. Frame thickness matters. Thicker sections hold heavy glass safely and last longer.

solid-wood-doors-and-windows.text: Solid Wood Doors & Windows in India
Our solid wood doors and windows are crafted to deliver timeless elegance, durability and natural aesthetics, making them ideal for luxury residential and premium architectural projects across India.
Solid Wood Doors and Windows in India : A Simple Guide for Every Homeowner

Are you building a new home or fixing up an old one? One of the first things people notice is your doors and windows. If you want something that looks good, lasts long, and keeps your home cool and safe, solid wood doors and windows in India are a great pick.

Wood has been used in Indian homes for hundreds of years. From Kerala teak to Sheesham in the north, every region has its own favorite wood. Today, many families are going back to natural materials because they want real quality that stands the test of time.
Why Pick Solid Wood?
Here are simple reasons why wood still wins over plastic or metal frames:
Stays Cool Inside
Wood does not trap heat. In hot places like Rajasthan or Tamil Nadu, wooden windows help keep rooms cooler.
Strong and Heavy
A solid wood door is hard to break. It gives better safety and privacy.
Looks Beautiful
The natural grain and color of wood add warmth to any room. You can polish it, paint it, or leave it plain.
Easy to Repair
If a small crack appears, a local carpenter can fix it. You do not need to replace the whole frame.
Long Life
With basic care like polishing once a year, good wood can last 30 to 50 years.
Best Wood Types You Will Find in India
Not all wood is the same. Here are the common types used here:
Teak
Very strong, resists termites, and handles rain well. It costs more but lasts the longest.
Sheesham (Indian Rosewood): Hard and durable. Great for carved doors
Sal
Strong and budget-friendly. Often used in eastern and central India.
Pine
Light in color and lighter on the pocket. Good for interior doors.
Red Meranti
A popular choice for window frames because it handles moisture better than many others.
Product Features
100% Made in Italy Craftsmanship.
Timeless Design Meets Modern Innovation.
Superior Material Quality & Durability.
Meticulous Attention to Detail.
Advanced Engineering for Smooth Performance.
Heritage Inspired, Future Ready.
What to Check Before You Buy
Buying the right frame is not hard if you keep these points in mind:
Check the Seasoning: Wood should be fully dry. Wet wood bends and cracks later.
Ask About Treatment: Good sellers treat the wood to stop termites and fungus.
Match Your Climate: If you live near the sea, pick wood that fights humidity. If you live in a dry zone, normal hardwood works fine.
Look at the Thickness: For main doors, go for at least 35 mm thickness. Windows can be slightly thinner.
Finish and Hardware: Ask if the price includes polish, handles, and hinges. This avoids surprise costs later.
Conclusion

Choosing solid wood doors and windows in India is a smart move if you care about comfort, safety, and looks. Pick the right wood for your weather, ask the right questions to your carpenter or dealer, and give it a little care every year. Your home will stay beautiful and strong for decades.

Steel Windows and Doors in India A Smart Choice for Modern Homes

If you are building a new home or giving your old one a fresh look, picking the right windows and doors is a big step. They keep your house safe, let in fresh air, and add beauty to your space. Steel windows and doors in India work well in all kinds of weather. Whether you live in a hot city like Chennai, a cold hill station, or a rainy place like Mumbai, steel frames can handle it all. Steel is much stronger than wood or aluminum. It gives better safety against break-ins and lasts longer without getting weak.
Less Care Needed

More Light
Steel frames are thin but tough. This gives more glass area and more natural light inside your rooms.
Modern Look

Fire Safe
Steel does not catch fire easily. This adds extra protection for your family, especially in kitchens and main exits.
Termite Proof
Unlike wood, steel does not attract termites. You never have to worry about holes or insect damage.

Today, you can find steel windows and doors in India in many styles. From big French doors that open to your balcony to simple sliding windows for your bedroom, there is something for every need. Many people worry about rust because of Indian humidity and coastal air. But modern steel frames come with a special powder coating that stops rust completely. So even if you live near the sea in Goa or in a humid city like Kolkata, you can use them without worry.

Steel windows and doors in India give you all three without burning a hole in your pocket. They are a one-time investment that pays off for decades.

Wood-Alu & Wood-Bronze Windows and Doors in India

Are you building a new home or renovating an old one in India? Choosing the right windows and doors is one of the most important decisions you will make. You need something that looks beautiful inside, fights the harsh weather outside, and does not drain your wallet with constant repairs. That is exactly why more and more Indian homeowners are moving toward Wood-Alu and Wood-Bronze windows and doors.
What Are Wood-Alu and Wood-Bronze Windows and Doors?

Think of them as windows and doors with the best of both worlds. On the inside, you see and touch real wood. It feels warm, looks classic, and adds a natural charm to your rooms. On the outside, a strong metal skin takes all the punishment from the weather. Wood-Alu uses aluminum on the outside, while Wood-Bronze uses bronze. This metal shell protects the wooden core from rain, dust, scorching sun, and salty coastal air. You enjoy the beauty of wood without the usual headache of warping, rotting, or termite attacks.
Why Indian Homes Need Them

In coastal cities, salt in the air eats away normal metal fittings. Wood-Alu and Wood-Bronze windows and doors handle all of this. The outer metal layer fights the weather, while the inner wood stays safe and dry. You spend less time fixing things and more time enjoying your home.
Benefits That Matter to You
Handles All Weather: The aluminum or bronze cladding resists rust, corrosion, and strong UV rays. Your frames stay strong year after year.
Looks Great Inside: Real wood interiors give your home a rich, natural feel that plain metal or plastic can never match.
Saves Power: These frames seal tightly and insulate well. They keep hot air out in summer and trap warmth in winter, which means lower electricity bills.
Strong Security: The solid build and high-quality locks make it much harder for intruders to break in.
Blocks Noise: If you live near a busy street, the tight seal helps keep traffic noise outside where it belongs.
Lasts for Decades: Unlike plain wood that needs yearly polishing or aluminum that dents easily, these mixed frames stay solid with just basic cleaning.

railings-fixed-plungeable-railing.text: Fixed & Plungeable Glass Railings in India
Our fixed and plungeable glass railing systems are designed to offer unobstructed views, safety and modern aesthetics for premium residential and commercial projects.
Fixed and Plungeable Glass Railings in India : A Simple Guide for Modern Homes

If you want a balcony or staircase that looks open, bright, and safe, Fixed & Plungeable Glass Railings in India are a smart pick. They give you a clear view without blocking light, and they keep your family safe at the same time. Let us break this down in the simplest way possible.
What Are Fixed & Plungeable Glass Railings?

Fixed glass railings are strong glass panels that stay firmly attached to your floor, wall, or staircase with metal brackets or channels. They do not shake or move. They just stand there and do their job.

Plungeable glass railings work a little differently. Here, the bottom edge of the glass panel is set deep into a metal channel or base shoe fixed to the floor. It looks like the glass is rising straight out of the ground. This gives a very clean, frameless look that many modern homes and offices love.
Both types use tough safety glass usually tempered or laminated so even if something hits it hard, it does not break into sharp pieces.
Why Homeowners in India Prefer These Railings
Unblocked Views: You can see right through them. Perfect for sea-facing apartments, hill homes, or city terraces.
More Sunlight: Since glass is clear, natural light flows in freely. Your space looks bigger and brighter.
Strong and Safe: The glass is heat-treated to handle heavy impact. It also meets Indian safety rules for height and load.
Easy to Clean: A quick wipe with glass cleaner is all it takes. No painting, no polishing, no rust.
Weather Proof: Good-quality railings handle heavy rain, strong sun, and dusty winds without losing their shine.
Modern Look: They match well with marble, wood, tiles, and concrete. Your home instantly looks premium.
The Cortizo Connection

When we talk about world-class aluminium frames and channels for glass railings, Cortizo is a name that stands out globally. This Spanish brand is known for slim, strong, and beautiful aluminium systems. In India, many top manufacturers now use Cortizo-style aluminium channels and fittings to build fixed and plungeable glass railings that match international standards. So when you choose a railing made with Cortizo-level hardware, you get the same sleek European finish right here in India.

mosquito-screens-india.text: Manual & Motorized Mosquito Screens in India

Our manual and motorized mosquito screens are designed to provide effective insect protection, seamless functionality and modern aesthetics, making them ideal for residential and commercial spaces across India.
Manual and Motorized Mosquito Screens in India: Keep Your Home Safe and Bite-Free
Why Mosquito Screens Matter for Indian Homes

Living in India means dealing with mosquitoes almost all year round. These tiny insects are not just annoying, they spread dangerous diseases like dengue, malaria, and chikungunya. Many families use chemical sprays, coils, or liquid vaporizers to keep mosquitoes away. But these products only work for a short time and may cause breathing problems or skin allergies, especially in children and elderly family members.

This is where manual & motorized mosquito screens in India come in as a smart, long-lasting solution. They create a strong physical barrier between your family and harmful insects while allowing fresh air and natural light to enter your home. You can keep your windows and doors open without worrying about mosquito bites, dust, or small insects flying inside.

Whether you live in a compact city apartment, a spacious villa, or a coastal home, installing the right mosquito screen helps you enjoy a healthier, more comfortable life without depending on harmful chemicals.
Types of Mosquito Screens: Choose What Fits Your Home
1. Manual Mosquito Screens
Manual screens are simple, hand-operated systems that you open and close yourself. They are budget-friendly and work well for most Indian homes.
Sliding Screens: These move smoothly along a track, just like your regular sliding windows. They are perfect for balconies, patios, and wide door openings.
Hinged Screens: These open like a normal door with sturdy hinges. They are ideal for main entrances and kitchen doors.
Fixed Frame Screens: These are permanently attached to your window frame. They are low-cost, zero-maintenance, and great for windows that stay closed most of the time.
Magnetic Screens: These attach to your window or door frame using magnetic strips. They are easy to install and remove, making them perfect for rented homes.
2. Motorized Mosquito Screens

Motorized screens are modern, automatic systems that roll up or slide open with the press of a button or through a remote control. They are perfect for large openings, luxury homes, and people who want extra convenience.
Remote-Controlled Operation: Open or close your screens without getting up from your sofa or bed.
Smart Home Integration: Some advanced models connect with your home automation system, allowing you to control them through your smartphone or voice commands.
Space-Saving Design: When not in use, motorized screens neatly roll away into a compact box, keeping your interiors looking clean and modern.
Key Benefits of Installing Mosquito Screens
Here is why more and more Indian families are switching to manual & motorized mosquito screens in India:
Complete Insect Protection: Fine mesh blocks mosquitoes, flies, cockroaches, and even tiny dust particles from entering your home.
Better Air Quality: Unlike closed AC rooms, screens let fresh outdoor air circulate freely, reducing indoor stuffiness and odors.
Chemical-Free Living: Say goodbye to smelly mosquito coils and harmful sprays. Screens protect your family naturally.
Child and Pet Safety: Sturdy frames and pet-resistant mesh options prevent accidental falls and keep your furry friends safe.
Uninterrupted Views: High-quality transparent mesh lets you enjoy your garden, balcony, or street view without any visual blockage.
Low Maintenance: A simple wipe with a damp cloth once a week keeps your screens clean and working like new.
Product Features
Advanced Mosquito Screen Technology.
Effective Even Against Bedbugs.
Minimal & Elegant Design.
Neoscenica® Universal Adaptability.
ANIMA21® Patented Windproof System.
Long-Lasting Build Quality.
Where to Install Mosquito Screens in Your Home
Bedroom Windows
Enjoy peaceful sleep without the buzzing sound of mosquitoes near your ears.
Balcony Doors
Keep your balcony open for morning tea or evening relaxation without insect trouble.
Kitchen Windows
Let cooking smells escape while blocking flies and insects from reaching your food.
Living Room Openings
Maintain a bright, airy atmosphere for guests and family time.
Children's Rooms: Create a safe zone where kids can play and study without mosquito bites.
Final Thoughts

Protecting your family from mosquitoes does not have to mean breathing in chemicals or keeping all windows shut. Manual & motorized mosquito screens in India offer a clean, safe, and smart way to enjoy your home fully. They fit every budget, match every home style, and most importantly, give you peace of mind.

If you are tired of mosquito bites, sleepless nights, and harmful repellents, it is time to invest in quality mosquito screens. Choose the right type for your home, get expert installation, and experience the comfort of a truly insect-free living space

If your family grows or your business expands, you can move or replace the partition instead of rebuilding the whole place.
Types of Internal Partitions You Can Choose

Wooden or drywall partitions

Sliding or folding partitions

Fabric or modular screens
Light, cheap, and easy to move. They suit rental homes or temporary workspaces.

pergolas-skylights-india.text: Pergolas & Skylights in India
Our pergolas and skylight systems are designed to enhance natural light, outdoor comfort and modern aesthetics, making them ideal for premium residential and commercial architectural spaces.
Pergolas and Skylights in India: Smart Outdoor Shade and Natural Light Solutions

India’s weather is beautiful but harsh. The summer sun burns bright, and the monsoon brings heavy rain. Many homeowners want to enjoy their balconies, terraces, and gardens without suffering from heat or getting wet. At the same time, people inside their homes want more daylight without the glare. This is exactly where Pergolas and Skylights in India become the perfect answer.
What Are Pergolas?

A pergola is an outdoor structure with columns and a roof made of beams or slats. It is usually built over a patio, garden path, or terrace. Pergolas do not fully block the sky. Instead, they give partial shade and allow fresh air to pass through. You can grow climbing plants like money plant or bougainvillea on them. This makes your outdoor area look green, cool, and relaxing.
In Indian homes, pergolas are very popular on rooftops and in backyard gardens. They create a private corner for morning tea, evening family time, or small get-togethers.
What Are Skylights?

A skylight is a window installed on the roof or ceiling of a house. It allows natural sunlight to enter rooms that do not have normal wall windows. Skylights are great for bathrooms, staircases, hallways, and kitchen areas. They reduce the need for electric lights during the day and make the home feel more open and fresh.
Why Indian Homes Need Them

Indian cities are crowded. Most apartments and houses have limited open space. Pergolas help you use your outdoor area better. Skylights help you bring the sky inside. Together, they solve two big problems: too much sun outside and too little light inside.
Key Benefits
Saves electricity: Skylights cut down daytime power use. Pergolas keep rooms cooler by shading windows.
Adds beauty: A wooden or metal pergola increases the look of your home. Skylights give a modern touch to ceilings.
Better health: Natural light improves mood and sleep. Fresh outdoor air under a pergola reduces stress.
Weather protection: Pergolas with polycarbonate sheets block rain. Skylights with toughened glass resist storms.
Higher property value: Homes with smart outdoor and daylight features sell faster in the Indian market.
Product Features
Enhanced Indoor–Outdoor Living Experience.
Natural Light Optimization.
Stylish & Functional Outdoor Shading.
Customizable to Any Space.
Modern Architectural Appeal.
Weather-Resilient & Durable Systems.
Choosing the Right Option

Before you buy, look at your space. For outdoor areas, pick weather-proof material like aluminium or treated wood. For skylights, choose double-layer glass if you live in very hot cities like Delhi or Jaipur. Always hire a trained installer. Poor fitting can cause leaks or cracks.

accessibility-statement.text: FAQ
1. Why should I go to Sumptuous?

Sumptuous' solution is a total package! It blends modern design, top-notch functionality, and end-to-end service to guide you through the entire process. Think of it like having a personal guide – we've got you covered from start to finish!
Our Door & window solutions are one of the best in the world, which means they offer unmatched in solution’s, resistance to noise, dust, air pollution, cyclones & heavy rains.
That’s not all. Sumptuous solutions are totally flexible & customisable - pick your fave colour, finish, and accessories. You get to make it yours
2. Certified solutions?

Since all our systems are from Europe, they are certified as per very stringent quality & performance criteria’s as per European (International) norms to withstand extreme weather conditions and security requirements.
3. Why are aluminium windows better than other types of windows?
Aluminium beats other window materials by a long mile, on almost every parameter.
It is eternally recyclable, making it an environmentally-friendly choice.
Aluminium windows can be customised in unlimited and longer-lasting colours, and have a much smoother finish.
As aluminium is a non-corrosive metal, there is no possibility of rusting. This simply means these are very easy to maintain.
100% safe under all conditions, especially extreme weather conditions.

It offers superior resistance to water and wind. Aluminium windows come with an in-built drainage system so there are no water leakages. They are also designed to withstand extreme wind-pressure, even cyclonic winds.
4. Can I get customised windows?

Yes, you can. You have an unlimited choice of colours to select from, and a range of accessories and finishes: anodized, wood coated and powder coating. Your window expert will guide you through the process of selecting a design that enhances the beauty of your home.
5. What kind of maintenance do windows require?

Aluminium windows require very little maintenance, as aluminium is a non-corrosive material and does not rust. Our quality finishing also ensures that colours look new and fresh for years. We also offer the best-in-class warranty.
6. How do I get started with the process?

It’s simple, all you need to do is book a free consultation by sending an email to info@sumptuousindia.com. Our window expert will understand your home, your requirements and your design preferences. The expert will then guide you through every stage: from selecting to customising to purchasing your windows.
